## Overview

Edoxaban is described in the supplied sources as a direct oral factor Xa inhibitor with proven antithrombotic effects ([src_1bcbd58b429315ec591b7e167517461a](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_1bcbd58b429315ec591b7e167517461a.md)). It is administered once daily in the atrial fibrillation population.

## Dosing studied in atrial fibrillation

- High-dose and low-dose once-daily regimens were compared with dose-adjusted [warfarin](./warfarin.md) in a global trial of 21,105 patients ([src_1bcbd58b429315ec591b7e167517461a](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_1bcbd58b429315ec591b7e167517461a.md)).
- A once-daily 15-mg dose was compared with placebo in very elderly Japanese patients (≥80 years) who were not considered appropriate candidates for standard anticoagulant doses ([src_0e9d75e95b4aa172897de8e3f4333228](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_0e9d75e95b4aa172897de8e3f4333228.md)).

## Development and sponsorship

The ENGAGE AF-TIMI 48 trial was funded by Daiichi Sankyo Pharma Development, and the ELDERCARE-AF trial was funded by Daiichi Sankyo ([src_1bcbd58b429315ec591b7e167517461a](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_1bcbd58b429315ec591b7e167517461a.md), [src_0e9d75e95b4aa172897de8e3f4333228](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_0e9d75e95b4aa172897de8e3f4333228.md)).
